verdicts.why: This is the teenage Ororo serving as Apocalypse's Horseman in X-Men: Apocalypse (1983). The owner's rule files Apocalypse as Earth-TRN414.

Charles and Erik recruit her to the CIA's Division X. She defects to Shaw's Hellfire Club during the attack on the base, and after Shaw dies she joins Erik's Brotherhood. Nothing supports an earlier Erik's Mutants stage.
He is in Stryker's Team X in the 1973 prologue and only later works for the Weapon X program hunting Logan. The leading Weapon X stage is out of order.
Logan is not covered by the owner's Fox rule. Marvel Database files the Munsons as Will, Kathryn and Nate Munson (Earth-17315).
Logan is not covered by the owner's Fox rule. Marvel Database files the children as Transigen Experiments (Earth-17315), and its Earth-17315 page names Transigen (Earth-17315).
Marvel Database's Laura (Earth-17315) gives Reality = Earth-17315 and says she is currently displaced to Earth-10005 after Deadpool & Wolverine. Her native Earth is 17315.
Marvel Database's Horsemen of Apocalypse (Earth-13393), first seen in X-Men '97 Season 2 1, lists Death, Famine, Pestilence and War under Reality Earth-13393.
Trask appears only in Days of Future Past's 1973 storyline, and the owner's rule files that as Earth-TRN414, which overrides Marvel Database's Earth-10005.

This Blob is a Void variant, not Deadpool's world. Marvel Database gives his Reality as Unknown, a Blob 'from an unspecified reality' grouped under the catch-all TRN872. The Azazel, Callisto, Juggernaut and Lady Deathstrike records the proposal cites are the original film characters, not Void variants. The deliberate null, like fox-gambit-void's, stands.
In X-Men '97 S2E5 Marvel Database lists Sabretooth (Graydon Creed Sr.) as a featured member of Team X (Earth-92131), with Wolverine, Morph and Lady Deathstrike, for the Weapon X raid.
X-Men '97 S2E6 lists Carl Denti under the Purifiers in their first appearance. His Marvel Database page gives his affiliation as Purifiers, formerly Friends of Humanity.

John Allerdyce is already a student at Xavier's school in X-Men (2000): he makes the fireball in Storm's class that Bobby freezes, and he is on file for that title. The X-Men stage starts there, not in X2.
In S2E9 she only teams with Carter against Strange Supreme, and the Watcher sends her home. She 'eventually joined' Carter's Guardians of the Multiverse, first shown in S3E7 (WI307).

At the end of S2E9 the Watcher returns her to her world. 'Sometime after parting ways with Watcher' she forms the new Guardians with Kahhori, Byrdie and Storm, first shown in S3E7 (WI307). That stage belongs to S3.
In 1944 he works for the Nazis as Klaus Schmidt, and the Hellfire Club begins in 1950s Las Vegas. The leading Hellfire Club stage before Nazi Germany is out of order.

Victor fights in the U.S. Army's wars, then joins Stryker's Team X. After it breaks up he works with Stryker capturing mutants for Weapon X, and he finally breaks with Stryker. The stages need the order Army, Team X, Weapon X, Independent.
Wade is a Team X member in 1973. Six years later, after Team X broke up, Stryker turns him into Weapon XI. The leading Weapon X stage is out of order.
Logan saves him at Nagasaki in 1945 while he is a Japanese soldier, and he founds the Yashida Corporation in 1953. The leading Yashida Corporation stage before the Imperial Japanese Army is wrong.

She defected from the Red Room and killed Dreykov before joining S.H.I.E.L.D., and the wiki lists the Red Room only as former. In S2E5 she fights the Red Room rather than rejoining it, so a Red Room stage after S.H.I.E.L.D. is wrong.

In WI303 (episode 21) he joins the Avengers at the 2012 Battle of New York, pushing into the circle between Captain America and Black Widow, and the wiki lists Avengers as his current affiliation. Once a second stage exists, the first needs the S3 title.
This is Captain Carter's world's Steve Rogers, the twin of A:by-steve-rogers-stomper. Marvel Database files him as Steven Rogers (Earth-82111), so null (main MCU) is wrong.

His U.S. Army, SSR and Howling Commandos service happens on screen in S1E1, as the twin file already records, so the owner's on-screen rule dates those stages to S1. Caveat: this villain file's steps list only S2.

Nothing returns him to the U.S. military after Wakanda and the Guardians. Marvel Database lists U.S. Navy, Stark Industries and the Guardians all as former affiliations, so the trailing U.S. Military stage has no basis.
In episode 9 he turns on the Guardians to take Ultron's Stones, a real departure under the 'turns on it' rule, and he joins no group after. Marvel Database lists the Guardians as former.

He is a former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who went rogue after Hope's death, before the episode; he even uses Hope's old clearance. In S1E3 he is never in S.H.I.E.L.D. and acts alone throughout, so a S.H.I.E.L.D. stage from S1 is false.
His break with S.H.I.E.L.D. is backstory before S1E3, and nothing in the episode is a departure from a group; being captured is not one. With no S.H.I.E.L.D. stage, the S1 left has nothing to record.

Marvel Database files her as Sibyl (Earth-199999), Reality = Earth-199999. The owner's rule is to use Marvel Database designations, and the existing record's own source notes this designation as a caveat.
Marvel Database gives his affiliation as Guardians of the Multiverse, with Masters of the Mystic Arts as former. Nothing on screen returns him to the Masters after he joins the Guardians in S1E9.

Marvel Database lists Johnny as a Resistance (Void) member in Deadpool & Wolverine and gives his affiliation as Resistance (Void), formerly Fantastic Four. The FF stage gets its first title, Fantastic Four (2005).

Deadpool & Wolverine names Matt Murdock (Earth-701306) among the dead Resistance members; he is only mentioned. Marvel Database lists his affiliations as Nelson and Murdock and Resistance (Void), and death is not a departure.

Geoffrey never works for Wizard in seasons 1–2. In S3 (RW306/RW307), bewitched by Morgan le Fay, he joins Wizard Computers. Dagger knocks him out in RW308 and he wakes free of the spell, then rallies PRIDE to save Molly in RW309. The wiki lists Wizard as former.
